Unchanged at HYPOTHESIS, which is also the registry and current status (research/claims/registry.json; codex/claim_state.json latest_event_by_claim C-PRODUCT-ECON = EXP-INTEL-36293264917). The registered next_gate is 'end-to-end amortized economics on real agents' and NONE of its components was measured: provenance.json.environment records model_calls 0, model_tokens 0, api_key_present false, embedding_service unavailable, no browser and no third-party packages, and the single cost basis is counted HTTP requests against an in-process stdlib substrate (cost_basis 'counted real HTTP requests observed at the client'). There is no model-call cost, no token cost, no retrieval cost, no verification cost, no repair cost, no latency and no maintenance cost, and the substrate is self-authored, so no per-successful-task saving can be computed. The packet does supply the one ingredient that eleven prior non-identifying outcomes lacked -- a comparator with genuine measured dynamic range, an amortized ratio of 0.5447 against it, and an induction cost of 152 counted by the client rather than estimated -- and that is recorded as inherited state, not as a measurement of the claim. Two hard prohibitions travel with it. First, 0.5447 must never be cited as C-PRODUCT-ECON evidence: the same run produced 2.1875 against B-LITERAL-REPLAY and 0.9722 against B-RETRIEVAL-K5, and both of those baselines are invalid comparators (task success 0.0000), so decision_rule condition 5's 'matched end-to-end success' has no referent. Second, B-LITERAL-REPLAY returns HTTP 200 on 126/126 tasks while accomplishing 0 of them at 1.0159 requests per task, i.e. cheaper than the treatment, because it silently acts on the wrong entity; any economic comparison that charges the treatment for work a do-nothing arm also performs is an accounting artifact, and this exact failure mode was the parent's rejected 13.67.

I refuse to encode this as a downgrade, because a control-plane and substrate-certification failure is infrastructure, and AGENTS.md forbids converting infrastructure failure into a scientific negative about the claim. Three new adverse facts are recorded for the next designer and none of them adjudicates C-MEAS-VALID. (1) The freeze gate cannot bind code, verified by the Director at source: scripts/freeze_experiment.py writes exactly three sha256 keys (request.json, spec.json, prereg.md) and scripts/check_scope.py stage_policy gives stage 'design' prefixes [] with exact [spec.json, prereg.md, failure.json, model_design.json] and grants allowed_code_roots only at 'execute'. Any prereg requiring committed, hash-verified code before freeze is therefore unsatisfiable in EVERY lane. This is the third independent reproduction, after EXP-GRAPH-36287167610 (V9) and EXP-INTEL-36293264917, reached here through a different clause (prereg section 5), and it blocks every future product-lane prereg with a build step. (2) The substrate digest is not a design audit. The frozen substrate matched its declared sha256 d3fe358ed68d38a0cf5ecd2c0dbabb943c8f9f5f531755fa2580cbeffbb20f26 exactly and still served none of the endpoints prereg section 7 declares: raw_evidence/substrate_surface_probe.json records /api/v1/schema, /api/v1/items/item-1, /api/v1/products/PROD-100, /api/v1/collections and /api/v1/categories all 404, POST /auth/token 401, and ?page=1&page_size=10 returning 200 with no Link header and ignored parameters. The real surface is /{collection}/{id} with ?q= and ?limit= plus GET /, three static tokens, no issuance endpoint, TOKEN_EXPIRY=100 on a monotone store. (3) The consequence for the claim's own next_gate is that this run's positive and null controls did discriminate on the mechanism (1.0000 and 126/126 abstention) while the frozen gate still returned NOT_DECIDABLE, so control discrimination is necessary but not sufficient for a decidable experiment.

(d) The passing transfer result comes from an added diagnostic arm, not the prereg-named Treatment, and promoting on it would be a post-hoc substitution of arms to flip a frozen gate. next_question: On a substrate that satisfies a preregistered surface contract and supplies at least 150 never-observed identifiers per family across at least two structurally different resource shapes, can a mechanism induced from observations of TWO structurally different resources -- with no hand-declared identity slot and no hand-supplied prefix rule -- learn which path segments are variable, and then transfer to a never-observed THIRD resource whose URL shape matches neither training resource, at task success >= 0.95 measured as verb AND status AND returned entity, and at amortized_cost_ratio <= 0.85 against an executed per-task cold-discovery baseline, with a mandatory null arm that induces from a single resource and is required to PIN (success <= 0.10) so that the test discriminates variability-observation from template-construction skill rather than reproducing the pinned-treatment result of this packet?
reason: The transaction is adjudicated as a measurement-validity failure of the GATE, not a scientific falsification, and it simultaneously contains the program's first valid positive transfer measurement. Both halves must be preserved without collapsing one into the other. Producer result.json status MEASUREMENT_INVALID with outcome MIXED and decision_rule_evaluation.gate_result NOT_DECIDABLE_AS_FROZEN; independent audit.json status PASS with producer_claim_supported=false, eight required_fixes and a claim_ceiling that this verdict adopts and does not extend. I adopt all of the audit's recomputed metrics, each carrying matches_producer=true, and I add two Director verifications at source. FIRST, the gate is undecidable for three reasons that must not be pooled: one genuine mechanism result (the prereg-named Treatment at 0.0000 with a diagnosed structural cause), three clauses that cannot discriminate as written (F2 unsatisfiable on a substrate with no /api/v1 prefix and self-contradictory with prereg T1 at prereg.md:30 versus :93; F6 the algebraic identity N_MAX = ceil(induction_cost/(mean_bcold - treatment)) equal to the break-even expression, verified numerically at 50 == 50 with n_max_frozen absent from both spec.json and freeze.json; F9 requiring a correctly abstaining arm to cost at least as much as B-COLD), and one substrate capacity shortfall (F12, 42 per family against a preregistered 50, because the frozen substrate exposes 126 resource-B identifiers). Reporting the conjunction as FALSIFIES would convert design and infrastructure defects into a scientific negative; reporting the packet as a clean SUPPORTS would convert a post-hoc added diagnostic arm into a passed gate. Neither is done. SECOND, below the gate, the audit's own bounded ceiling stands and is the real product of this cycle: prefix preservation is necessary but not sufficient, because a segment that never varies across the training set carries no evidence that it should vary, so induction from a single collection pinned the collection and scored 0.0000 on 126 never-observed identifiers, while the same pipeline with the variable resource declared reached 1.0000 CI [1.0000,1.0000] on those same identifiers at 1.0159 requests per task, at an amortized ratio of 0.5447 against an executed B-COLD of 4.0794 with break-even at 50 transfer tasks and 126 executed. This is not identifier leakage: the held-out resource-A indices 0-149 are disjoint from the training indices 150-199 and the resource-A and resource-B namespaces are disjoint by construction. The strongest safety datum is the null arm, which abstained 126/126 at zero requests and, with the gate bypassed, returned HTTP 200 everywhere while applying the wrong verb on 84/126 -- an independent reproduction of the parent's 80-wrong-action liability estimate, and proof that min_confidence is load-bearing; but the same run shows the gate guards intent and not slot values, since the treatment arms accepted 20/20 out-of-support bindings and 10/20 empty strings. THIRD, the mandate's central DURABLE requirement is unestablished and I decline to infer it in either direction. The Director verified that the corrected kernel is committed at HEAD 6e07ba02 via f9f85062, with git diff 244dd5bd..f9f85062 -- src tests at 3 files and 633 insertions and the committed blob digest equal to the cited d64a4bf4..., which corrects the stale working-tree-only statement in audit.validity_findings[0] and provenance.json.git_state without rewriting either file; but because this verdict sets promote_to_product false, spider-lane.yml line 324 will run revert_product_reject.py and restore the three product-root files to 27f616c5, deleting the capability again. Durability therefore remains not established, and the fifteenth add-at-execute/delete-at-verdict cycle is now mechanically predicted rather than merely observed. continue is false because every remaining blocker is a design or control-plane repair that requires a new Global Research Director mandate and a re-freeze, the substrate and the gate must both be rebuilt, and an immediate re-chain would measure against a delta that is about to be deleted. C-PARAM-INHERIT is held at EXPERIMENTAL, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY at EXPERIMENTAL, C-PRODUCT-ECON at HYPOTHESIS and C-MEAS-VALID at EXPERIMENTAL; the claim domain, the architecture and the Product lane all remain open, and nothing in this verdict authorizes closing them or shipping anything.
